lobotriscid.name: Lobotriscid
lobotriscid.description: A muscular, three-tailed fish, the Lobotriscid trawls through Exocrine vapor across the surface of Deimos when Vome is dominant.

longwinder.name: Longwinder
longwinder.description: Repairs leaks and clear blockages within the aqua systems. It can be found in the lake on Venus.
